numeric_protocol.baseline: Original upstream CUDA body, extern C and symbol normalization only; same compiler, macro shapes, reset and timing path as candidate
host_adaptations: Original .cu/.cuh saved. Original executable and percentage-difference checker are NOT used.
NI/NJ/NK/N remain compile-time strides; _PB macros use runtime arguments; logical dimensions equal allocated extents in tested cases.
Rectangular launch grid uses x=columns,y=rows; upstream GEMM/2DConv host reverses extents. Device arithmetic unchanged.
gesummv original GPU tmp/y inputs uninitialized by its host: explicitly zero-initialize both before every invocation.
syr2k original CPU sums two products separately but GPU sums them before accumulation: the strict oracle follows the CUDA grouping.
2D convolution CUDA term order differs from original CPU loop: oracle follows the CUDA expression order.
Convolution outputs initialized; boundaries must remain bitwise unchanged. Full output and scratch state is verified.
3D convolution repeated offset terms retained exactly; not repaired into another stencil.
Performance sizes use upstream MINI/SMALL extents; extra ragged correctness sizes and initialized-data streams are ours, not claims of original published timings.
numeric_protocol.measurement: CUDA event time per full invocation, output reset excluded before EACH invocation; average 1..128 invocation durations; hot/reset buffers; original-vs-candidate AB/BA
numeric_protocol.numerical_inputs: Stock-like initialization plus two deterministic signed finite FP32 input streams including selected signed zero/subnormal cases; gesummv tmp/y start +0.
numeric_protocol.sanitizers: memcheck/initcheck/racecheck/synccheck on largest small ragged shape for all 3 data seeds; bitwise checks also on all performance shapes
numeric_protocol.strict_semantics: FP32, no FMA/reassociation/fast-math/TF32; compare all live-out bytes; finite selected tests, not formal equivalence
numeric_protocol.timing_input: seed=4327; output is restored each invocation; no accumulating overflow across repetitions
numeric_protocol.timing_repetitions: 2 sessions x 8 AB/BA pairs; baseline-only calibration 5ms target with max128; candidate cannot affect repetitions
